question: Do independently checked metadata arithmetic and source/code cross-references justify a bounded, alias-labeled RNA description?
decision: Qualify RNA LogNormalize and original broad annotations for two explicit alias pairs; hold extra WT50/Mut50 dose comparisons and exact downstream-plot reproduction.
strongest_rival: Alias ordering, six-library metadata versus eight object conditions, and downstream cell exclusions could be mistaken for verified dose/library identities.
discriminator: Python reconstructs all sampled normalized values, checks recovery totals and warning effects, extracts exact archived marker vectors and explicitly grades the code/caption alias evidence.
exposure_record: Paper figures, captions, published markers, source/animal results and author code exposed. The biological RDS has not been deserialized before this first metadata freeze; earlier acquisition used only opaque byte hashes. V1 exposed object class Seurat and peak operational memory only before version serialization failed; no inventory or normalization results were produced. V2 and warning-review outputs are exposed. Eight aliases, no Micro_types and no mouse-assignment fields are known. No marker-expression results have been summarized.
biological_unit: One deposited pool/library per condition; cells nested in the observed pool, not independent mice.
nesting_and_overlap: S1 reports one old-control mouse and two pooled mice in the other main libraries, with no multiplexing. Shared controls serve both dose contrasts. Individual donor assignment requires separate provenance.
population_and_selection: All retained cells in the authorized main IL10_svz_seurat.rds and original broad Celltype annotations. No fresh clustering, integration, downsampling or marker-based exclusion.
contrast: Verification of stored arithmetic and condition eligibility; no treatment-expression contrasts.
endpoint: Independent normalization/recovery checks, warning diagnosis, marker provenance and alias-specific eligibility.
methods: Standard-library Python arithmetic independent of R; exact v2/review byte comparison; archived code regex extraction for 28 IL10-related and 20 IFN-related markers; explicit source/caption evidence grades.
missingness_and_exclusions: No new exclusions. Missing fields, absent genes/conditions, explicit sparse zeros, duplicate/misaligned barcodes and source discrepancies are reported. A failed required check stops dependent analyses rather than selecting favorable records.
multiplicity: Metadata and arithmetic checks only; no inferential P values or confidence intervals.
precision_basis: No population precision estimate. Exact stored recovery counts and bounded numerical tolerance qualify file arithmetic only.
interpretation_limit: No biological replication, population treatment effect, age interaction, mediation or repair inference. Downstream microglia exclusions and filename changes must remain distinct from broad deposited cells.
stop_rule: Stop on any arithmetic, byte-identity or source assertion failure. Unknown aliases remain held; no numeric ordering or accession/barcode join is invented.
amendment_reason: Independent qualification review after metadata and warnings became available; finite-pool interpretation retained.
